semantics: Volume of water passing a channel cross-section per time.
rationale: Generic physical quantity already in QUDT; no ecological specialization needed.

semantics: Photons (400-700 nm) per area per time.
rationale: Exact QUDT match; shares its unit with CO2 and photosynthesis fluxes, so attach by concept, not by unit.

semantics: Volume of water per total volume of soil.
rationale: QUDT VolumeFraction carries the ratio semantics; gravimetric water content maps to MassFractionOfWater.

semantics: Amount of substrate processed per mass of soil or tissue per time.
rationale: QUDT BiogeochemicalRate (mol/kg/s) is an ecological precedent defined generically over substance; enzyme assays fit it.

semantics: Mass of N transformed per mass of soil per time.
rationale: Existing QUDT ecological QK (kg/kg/s); the process belongs in an annotation.

semantics: Number of organisms per volume of water, sediment, or soil.
rationale: Generic QUDT QK (NumberDensity is the broader alternative); taxon belongs in an annotation.

semantics: Number of individuals.
rationale: Counts need no new QK; the matched GeneFamilyAbundance is not appropriate.

semantics: Mass of an element or compound produced, transformed, or transferred per unit ground or water-surface area per time.
rationale: Fills the per-area gap beside QUDT's BiogeochemicalRate and MassSpecificBiogeochemicalRate; one QK serves many processes, with process and substance in annotations.

semantics: Amount of substance produced, consumed, or exchanged per unit leaf, ground, or water-surface area per time.
rationale: Molar sibling of the mass-basis rate. MolarFluxDensity describes transport through a surface; the team should decide whether a biogeochemical specialization adds value.

semantics: Number of organisms per unit ground, bottom, or water-surface area.
rationale: QUDT has VolumetricEntityDensity but no areal counterpart; ParticleFluence (the automated suggestion) is a radiation quantity.

semantics: One-sided green leaf area per unit ground area.
rationale: Standard, well-defined ecological index used across many sites; ratio semantics are explicit.

semantics: One-sided fresh leaf area per unit leaf dry mass.
rationale: Core plant functional trait with a standard protocol; the automated parent (MassAttenuationCoefficient) is wrong.

semantics: Vertically projected area of a taxon or cover type per unit ground area.
rationale: Most widely used dimensionless ecological quantity in the corpus; the QUDT AmountOfCloudCover precedent shows cover QKs exist.

action: Team decision: named specialization of the areic rate
semantics: Net carbon or dry-mass gain by producers per ground area per time.
rationale: Only if named process QKs are wanted. Many NPP values use g/m2 with time implied (often per year); prefer explicit-time units.

action: Team decision: named specializations of the molar areic rate
semantics: Ecosystem CO2 exchange components per ground area per time.
rationale: Defined by FLUXNET conventions, but carbon-specific; evidence is concentrated in a few scopes.

semantics: Mean distance a solute travels downstream before uptake (Sw).
rationale: Standard stream-ecology metric, but used in only about 5 scopes.

semantics: Vertical velocity of solute removal from the water column (vf).
rationale: Pairs with uptake length; same limited evidence.

semantics: Dry soil mass per total soil volume, including pores.
rationale: Distinct from particle density and widely used, but medium-specific; ECSO already has a bulk density characteristic.

proposal: Dissolved oxygen and chlorophyll a concentrations
semantics: Mass of a constituent per volume of water.
rationale: Substance-specific (criterion 8); attach units to MassConcentration and annotate the substance (ChEBI) and medium (ENVO). The automated parent Density is too broad.

semantics: Mass of a material per ground or bottom area.
rationale: Stocks differ only in what is weighed; QUDT AreicMass (MassPerArea) suffices.

semantics: Mass of an organism, part, or sample.
rationale: Organism and part are entity context, not a quantity type.

semantics: Mass of organic carbon per mass of dry soil.
rationale: Substance-specific fraction; reuse MassFraction with stated ratio semantics.
